import subprocess,re
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','-z']).decode().split('\0')
patterns=[re.compile(rb'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])sk-(?:proj-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}'),re.compile(rb'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}'),re.compile(rb'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----')]
hits=[]
for p in filter(None,paths):
 if p.endswith(('.png','.jpg','.webp')): continue
 b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+p])
 if any(x.search(b) for x in patterns): hits.append(p)
print({'staged_files':len(list(filter(None,paths))),'possible_secret_paths':hits})
